# Recorded synthetic source oracles

These are byte-for-byte copies of only the synthetic input/output files consumed
by the name-search (31 cases) and JSON-object diagnostics (20 cases) tests.
The original captures remain unchanged under ws-replan/preparation/slices/S11/.
Their SHA256 pins remain asserted by the tests. Absolute `inputPath` fields are
original-capture provenance, not file locations to open on a CI runner.
No capture scripts, native owner data or credentials are included.
